cards.title: Personalized Memory
cards.body: Your digital twin gets smarter with every interaction, synthesizing your unique surgical techniques with real-time data to highlight important clinical insights and automate your documentation workflow — acting as a seamless extension of your expertise.
cards.shortBody: Peri catalogs your specific techniques, preferences, and clinical nuances across every encounter.

colleague.title: Your Digital Colleague
colleague.body: Peri serves as your clinical digital twin — a colleague to bounce ideas off for tough cases. It removes clinical isolation, decreases cognitive burden, and lets you return to the heart of medicine: patient care.

cards.title: EHR Integration
cards.body: Findings flow into the systems you already run on. Peri writes structured notes back to Epic and Cerner, so the record reflects the encounter without a second pass of data entry at the end of your day.

cards.title: Medico-legally Robust
cards.body: Every insight is traceable to the moment it was captured. Timestamped source media, clinician review before anything is signed, and an auditable trail from observation to documented finding.

philosophy.title: Built for doctors, by doctors.
philosophy.body: Our mission is to return the focus to patient-centered medicine. Join the community of clinicians reclaiming their practice through personalized digital intelligence.
